notablePrerequisites: Adarkar Valkyrie does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting Thermopod.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
When Thermopod dies, Adarkar Valkyrie triggers, returning Thermopod from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Thermopod enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
